mechanism: On-policy expert corrections: data generation for supervised finetuning of multi-turn SWE agents
evidence_scope: We introduce on-policy expert corrections (OECs), par- tially on-policy data generated by starting rollouts with a student model and then switching to an expert model part way through the trajectory.
evidence_role: Taking inspiration from the classic DAgger algorithm, we propose a novel data generation methodology for addressing covariate shift for multi-turn LLM training.
